# Refactoring for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/refactoring/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/refactoring
```

- 36 skills (including 6 mode skills), each also a slash command `/refactoring:refactoring-<name>`.
- 22 subagents, started with `@refactoring-<name> <task>`.
